_comment: Global defaults apply to every category unless overridden below. Each category can override any subset of: count, max_faces, max_vertices_in_face, max_vertices, min_vertices, seed.

1_triangulation_subdivide_1._comment: Delaunay triangulation, subdivide each edge once. Leave empty {} to use defaults, or override any field below.

3_triangulation_subdivide_3._comment_example: subdividing 3x triples face-boundary lengths, so this category often needs a larger max_vertices_in_face than the others -- e.g. uncomment below.

4_halin._comment_example: Halin graphs need max_faces >= 4 (mathematical minimum, see gen_halin.py).

5_cycles._comment_example: Only 13 distinct (non-isomorphic) cycle graphs exist (n=3..15), so requesting more than 13 here will always produce a shortfall warning -- see gen_cycles.py.

6_cycle_union._comment_example: Cycle unions only reach k in [2,4], so max_faces above 5 has no effect on this category (faces = k+1).
